brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: North-half bases at levels 0, 1 and 2 in cell 0,0, snapped together.
A drawer sits on the cut face of the level 0 base. The middle storey has no drawer.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: One full-depth open bin sits on the level 2 base. The brief says bins, plural, and I placed only one.

finish.summary: I built a three-storey tower from half bases. The bottom storey has a drawer and the top storey has one open bin. The middle storey is plain, with end caps on its open faces. I capped the other open faces and locked the joints. check_build reports no issues and the meshes are clear. I added no props.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
